title: Genetic Variation and Immune Responses After Injury
brief_summary: Our overall hypothesis is that genetic variations in innate immunity genes predispose patients to varying responses after injury by altering the systemic and local inflammatory responses. In addition, we hypothesize that these genetic differences are associated with different clinical outcomes
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: All burn,trauma, or acute surgery victims admitted to the surgical, burn or trauma units within 24 hours of injury will be considered for inclusion.

Exclusion Criteria:severe immunosuppression, DNR, severe trauma, terminal diseases.
